run.name: Builders FirstSource, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (BLDR)
run.summary: Builders FirstSource's credit position is weakening but liquidity remains ample: reported total debt to EBITDA rose to 5.15x from 3.26x as housing weakness cut earnings, while no note or revolver matures before 2030. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (income from operations plus D&A), not printed, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Twelve months to September 30, 2026, derived as FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025. Debt principal 4,658.904 million, cash 55.012 million, EBITDA 904.402 million. Management reports 4.1x net debt to Adjusted EBITDA on its own definition, not comparable. Calculation C6

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. EBITDA 904.402 million over derived cash interest 284.752 million. On management Adjusted EBITDA 1,129.1 million the same ratio would be 3.97x, a management-basis figure shown only for reference. Calculation C7

cash.basis: Cash. Net excess availability after 197.0 million borrowed and 75.6 million of letters of credit. Commitments less borrowings less letters of credit would be 1,927.4 million, but the borrowing base of 1,731.7 million is the binding limit. Qualified cash of 21.3 million overlaps cash. Facility matures May 20, 2030

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Legal documents, guarantors, ownership and end-market sales mix are not supplied, and EBITDA is built from reported lines rather than printed.
CP-1 main limitation: Filings print no EBITDA, so it is built from reported lines; management Adjusted EBITDA is higher, and the fixed charge coverage ratio is not reported.
